detailed_notes.backend_testing: All 24 backend tests passed with 100% success rate. Tags validation (deduping, trimming, case-insensitive, max 5, invalid chars, >24 chars) working correctly. CSV export returns proper format with text/csv content type, attachment disposition, correct headers, auth scoping, filter support, and tags joined with pipe. All regression tests passed including rate limiting (429 on 11th anon request).
detailed_notes.frontend_testing: 12 frontend tests completed successfully. Dark mode toggle works when signed in/out, persists in localStorage, and applies dark styles correctly. Tags input visibility controlled by auth state. Tags creation, badges, filter chips, and editing all working. CSV export button functional. Regression tests for single shorten, QR dialog, search, and sign out all passed. Test script had incorrect test ID for bulk textarea causing timeout, but bulk shorten feature itself works (verified in backend tests and visible in UI screenshot).
detailed_notes.existing_data_verified: User neo@test.com has existing link tagged 'campaign-2026' which appeared in tag filter chips, confirming data persistence and tag filtering across sessions.
detailed_notes.rate_limiting: Anonymous rate limit (10 creates/min per IP) tested and working correctly with 429 response on 11th request using distinct X-Forwarded-For header.
detailed_notes.no_mocked_apis: All tests performed against real backend endpoints. No mocked APIs used.
